lag.evidence_source: Wave 1 is 'Pregnancy weeks 15-19', Wave 2 is '6 months postpartum', and Wave 3 is '18 months postpartum'. The interval from 6 months postpartum to 18 months postpartum is 12 months (1.0 year). The interval from pregnancy weeks 15-19 (approx. 4 months before birth) to 6 months postpartum (6 months after birth) is approximately 10 months (0.83 years). The typical interval is approximately 1.0 year.
